tools.name: givingfuel_list_forms
tools.description: List the account's GivingFuel forms (donation / fundraising pages): id, name, status (open or closed), created and updated dates. Use the form ids to filter orders, transactions and subscriptions. GET /forms.

tools.name: givingfuel_get_form
tools.description: One form by id: name, status, accounting reference, time zone and its field layout. GET /forms/{id}.

tools.name: givingfuel_get_form_inventory
tools.description: Inventory items of a form (limited-quantity items): path, name, sold and remaining quantity. GET /forms/{id}/inventory.

tools.name: givingfuel_list_orders
tools.description: List donation orders (one per checkout): order number, donor billing name and address, form, total, currency and status, newest or oldest first. Filter by form, status, donor email, customer id, order number or dates. GET /search/orders.

tools.name: givingfuel_get_order
tools.description: One order by id with the donor's billing details, form, totals and status. Set include_transactions to embed the payments (charges and refunds) of the order. GET /search/orders/{id}.

tools.name: givingfuel_list_transactions
tools.description: List payment transactions (money movements): amount, deductible amount, currency, type (charge, refund, voucher), payment method, masked card, status, form and donor email. Filter by type, method, form, order, donor or dates. GET /search/transactions.

tools.name: givingfuel_get_transaction
tools.description: One transaction by id: amounts, type, payment method, masked card, gateway message and status. GET /search/transactions/{id}.

tools.name: givingfuel_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List recurring donations (subscriptions): amount, schedule, status, last and next payment date, payments remaining, form and donor email. Filter by form, status, donor, or next/last payment date. GET /search/subscriptions.

tools.name: givingfuel_get_subscription
tools.description: One recurring donation by id: amount, schedule, status, last and next payment, payments remaining. GET /search/subscriptions/{id}.

tools.name: givingfuel_list_customers
tools.description: List customer records (donors): id, email, billing name and address, lifetime amount, created and updated dates. Filter by email or dates. New donors can take up to 5 minutes to appear. GET /search/customers.

tools.name: givingfuel_get_customer
tools.description: One donor (customer record) by id: email, billing details and total amount. GET /search/customers/{id}.

tools.name: givingfuel_list_coupons
tools.description: List GivingFuel coupons: account-wide ones, or only those of one form when form_id is given. Shows discounts, codes, availability, redeemed count and expiry. GET /coupons/global or /coupons/forms/{id}.

tools.name: givingfuel_get_coupon
tools.description: One coupon by id with its discounts, codes, availability and redeemed counts. GET /coupons/{id}.

tools.name: givingfuel_create_coupon
tools.description: WRITE: create a discount coupon in the live GivingFuel account (it can be redeemed by donors right away). One discount (fixed amount or percent) and one or more codes; optionally limited to one form, to a number of uses, and to an expiry date. Not idempotent: calling it twice creates two coupons. PO

tools.name: givingfuel_delete_coupon
tools.description: WRITE: permanently delete a coupon from the live GivingFuel account; its codes stop working immediately and this cannot be undone. Show the coupon (givingfuel_get_coupon) and get the user's approval first, then call with confirm: true. GET /coupons/{id}, then DELETE /coupons/{id}.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "givingfuel_list_coupons" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: givingfuel_list_orders, givingfuel_list_transactions, givingfuel_get_transaction, givingfuel_list_subscriptions, givingfuel_list_customers, givingfuel_get_customer · Private data: givingfuel_list_customers, givingfuel_get_customer · Public sink: givingfuel_list_orders, givingfuel_list_transactions, givingfuel_list_subscriptions, givingfuel_list_customers, givingfuel_get_customer, givingfuel_create_coupon · Destructive: givingfuel_delete_coupon.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: givingfuel_list_orders, givingfuel_list_transactions, givingfuel_get_transaction, givingfuel_list_subscriptions, givingfuel_list_customers, givingfuel_get_customer · Private data: givingfuel_list_customers, givingfuel_get_customer · Public sink: givingfuel_list_orders, givingfuel_list_transactions, givingfuel_list_subscriptions, givingfuel_list_customers, givingfuel_get_customer, givingfuel_create_coupon · Destructive: givingfuel_delete_coupon

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
